title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out with Super Creek…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Look over there! It's filled with so many cute plushies

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look in the direction Super Creek is pointing and see a claw machine filled with stuffed Umamusume toys.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, they're so cute. I just want to take care of all of them!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But I've never really tried these machines before…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A troubled look spreads across Super Creek's face.
choice_data_list: Do you want me to win you one?
Do you want me to win you one?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Really? You'd do that for me? Well, if you're offering, then I gratefully accept!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Good luck! Oh, but don't push yourself too hard, okay? That's a big no-no!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail!
